answer: Because the voyage audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the quill bond on all of them and exposing each to the raven slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 14 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Collateral of 87 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
